_note: Episode 6 version 2 (the new form, same as videos/ep01v2-ang-unang-talon). Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (pipeline/draw_pick.py with the JSON prompt, one request at a time, three draws a still, the choice at 3x). Shot NN of shots.md -> full/bk_NN.jpg; the key of a shot is its first sentence. Silent shots are keys 100-108 shown inside a neighbouring sentence (shots_fx 'keys'): 8 -> k100 before s20, 13 -> k101 before s33, 15 -> k102 before s37, 21 -> k103 before s53, 26 -> k104 before s62, 29 -> k105 after s63, 30 -> k106 before s64, 33 -> k107 before s69, 41 -> k108 before s92 (100+ because sentences run to 96). Shot 44 is the quiet trivia card (not a still here). Writing added in code after the choice: bk_07 the phone message 'Basahin mo nang malakas.'; bk_35 M's note in handwriting; bk_43 the episode's question. The marker (shots 7, 8) is never shown with its face to us (its words were not read, so none are invented); the folded paper under the taho cup shows its blank back. The shooting is never drawn. Indio wears the era outfit in 1896 and no medallion from shot 30 on (indio_1896_bare).
